text: For neither ought the obedient to suspect that they are distrusted, nor the insolent to know that we fear them; because our fears augment the licentiousness of the latter, and diminish the zeal of the former.
author: Julius Caesar
speaker: Curio
reference: Commentaries on the Gallic and Civil Wars
locator: Civil War, Book II, Chapter XXXI
translation: W. A. McDevitte and W. S. Bohn, 1869
